fixes.explanation: Prophets? I get it, baker, this whole book is crawling with them. But Jesus says, "…just as I have received authority from My Father." (Revelation 2:27). No prophet handed Him a thing. Nobody had to hand it up from below, because it came straight from the Father.

His people? Ha, I like the heart on that one, baker. But Jesus says, "…just as I have received authority from My Father." (Revelation 2:27). It never worked its way up from the crowd like a vote at a meeting. It came down from the Father, and that's where His authority starts.
